# FIRE ComfyUI Workflows

> A maintained collection of 20 downloadable ComfyUI workflow JSON files for local AI image generation, video generation, identity editing, dataset preparation, and upscaling.

Canonical site: https://thefiregroupai-ops.github.io/comfyUI/
Source repository: https://github.com/thefiregroupai-ops/comfyUI

## Start here

- Workflow catalog: https://thefiregroupai-ops.github.io/comfyUI/workflows/
- Import guide: https://thefiregroupai-ops.github.io/comfyUI/guides/how-to-install-comfyui-workflow-json/
- Repository README: https://github.com/thefiregroupai-ops/comfyUI#readme

## Workflow families

- Ideogram and Flux: https://thefiregroupai-ops.github.io/comfyUI/workflows/ideogram-flux/
- Krea2: https://thefiregroupai-ops.github.io/comfyUI/workflows/krea2/
- LoRA dataset tools: https://thefiregroupai-ops.github.io/comfyUI/workflows/lora-dataset-tools/
- MiniMax H3 video: https://thefiregroupai-ops.github.io/comfyUI/workflows/minimax-h3-video/
- Qwen: https://thefiregroupai-ops.github.io/comfyUI/workflows/qwen/
- Upscalers and tools: https://thefiregroupai-ops.github.io/comfyUI/workflows/upscalers-tools/
- Wan video: https://thefiregroupai-ops.github.io/comfyUI/workflows/wan-video/

## Practical guides

- Character consistency: https://thefiregroupai-ops.github.io/comfyUI/guides/comfyui-character-consistency-guide/
- Wan image-to-video: https://thefiregroupai-ops.github.io/comfyUI/guides/comfyui-wan-video-guide/
- Krea2 identity and depth: https://thefiregroupai-ops.github.io/comfyUI/guides/krea2-comfyui-character-consistency/
- MiniMax H3: https://thefiregroupai-ops.github.io/comfyUI/guides/minimax-h3-comfyui/
- Qwen face swap: https://thefiregroupai-ops.github.io/comfyUI/guides/qwen-comfyui-faceswap-guide/

## Usage notes

- Workflow JSON files are starting points. Model files, custom nodes, and hardware requirements vary by workflow.
- Review model and custom-node licenses before commercial use.
- The repository does not currently declare a software license; see NOTICE.md for the practical effect.
- Community support: https://www.skool.com/fire-ai-creator-lab-9667
